Subject: RidgeView MAP checkpoint — missed this morning; timeline & next steps

Hi Sam / Claire —

I’m sorry we missed you on this morning’s MAP checkpoint. We waited 10 minutes on the call and didn’t see anyone join. I know things come up — hope everything is OK on your side.

Given the missed checkpoint I pulled together a short summary of the impact and an updated Mutual Action Plan (attached + Drive link below). High-level changes:
- Canary launch shifts ~3 weeks (was Apr 15 → now May 6)
- Security review window moves from Apr 1–8 → Apr 15–22
- Procurement sign-off pushed one week to Apr 29

Action requested: please confirm one of these times for a make-up checkpoint this week so we can re-align and lock the new milestones:
- Thu Mar 4, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu Mar 4, 15:00–15:30 PT
- Fri Mar 5, 09:00–09:30 PT

I’ve attached the revised MAP (RidgeView_UPDATED_MAP_v1.3.xlsx) and a short timeline change summary. If those dates won’t work I can also send a calendar poll.

Thanks — we’ll prioritize any action items that unblock procurement or security in the meantime.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Rishi —

Sorry about that — I got pulled into an urgent board prep call and couldn’t jump off. Appreciate the note and the quick update. The proposed times on Thu/ Fri look okay for me; Claire is traveling today but should be back tomorrow and can join one of the Thu slots.

Couple of quick Qs after skimming the attached:
- Does the 3-week shift affect the final SLA review or just the canary window? We have two customers that depend on the SLA date.
- Procurement expects a revised quote before their sign-off deadline; do we have an updated cost estimate tied to the new launch date?

I can do Thu Mar 4 at 10:00 PT. If that works for you all, lock it and we’ll bring procurement and security folks into the follow-up.

Thanks,
Sam
